blocks.text: This article describes how to configure Security Settings for users.
A user must be added before configuring the security settings. To learn more, see Adding Users.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Authentication > Users.
Click the Edit icon for the user you want to configure the security settings.
On the Edit User page, in the Security Settings section, configure the following fields:
Change Password Settings: Enable to modify the password configurations.
Password Option: Select the required option for the user's initial login:

Set By User: Select this option if the user must set their own password to access the Zscaler Admin Console. The user receives a password reset email. The user can choose and configure the required authentication method.
Set by Administrator: Select this option to set a password for the user:
Password: Enter a password for the user.
Confirm Password: Reenter the user's password.
Prompt for Password Change After the Initial Login: This option is selected by default. The user needs to change the password by following the guidelines defined in the password policy.
Auto-generated: Select this option to auto-generate a password for the user:
Password: Use the Copy and View icons to copy or view the password.
Prompt for Password Change After the Initial Login: This option is selected by default. The user needs to change the password by following the guidelines defined in the password policy.

Skip Second-Factor Authentication: Enable if you want the user to skip second-factor authentication. For the Skip Until option, select the date and time up to when the user can skip second-factor authentication. Post this duration, the user must configure second-factor authentication.

MFA Authenticator: Displays the MFA method configured for a user and the date and time it was last used to log in to Zscaler Admin Console. Click the Delete icon to remove the configured MFA option. The user is then prompted to reconfigure MFA the next time they log in to the Zscaler Admin Console.
